title: A Light Left Burning
text:
A girl in a too-large coat sits by a dying [amber]lantern[/amber], a fresh cut across her palm, sharpening a knife she does not need. Her party went deeper three days ago. She has started to forget their faces.

"If you're going down," she says, "I'm coming."

choices.label: Bind her hand
choices.outcome: Ilse cleans the cut and binds it. Tamsin flinches, then doesn't. She tells you their names while they are still there to tell, and shoulders her pack.

choices.label: Take her as your second
choices.outcome: Three passes. She is fast, and cheats, and grins when she loses. Brannoc nods once. That is enough.

choices.label: Take the faces she is losing
choices.outcome: Vesper takes the faces gently, the way you take a cup from someone asleep. Tamsin blinks, shoulders her pack, and walks back toward the surface, lighter and unsure why.
